python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal
import ast
import csv

root = Path.cwd()
people = ("小林", "小周", "小陈")
expected = {
    "expenses.csv": (8, Decimal("1240.30")),
    "expenses_partial_refund.csv": (12, Decimal("1439.31")),
}
for name, (count, total) in expected.items():
    path = root / name
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(source))
    assert len(rows) == count, (name, "row count", len(rows))
    actual = sum((Decimal(row["amount"]) for row in rows), Decimal("0"))
    assert actual == total, (name, "total", actual)
    for row in rows:
        assert row["payer"] in people, (name, "payer", row["payer"])
        amount = Decimal(row["amount"])
        assert amount != 0, (name, "zero amount")
        assert amount.as_tuple().exponent >= -2, (name, "precision")
        participants = row.get("participants", "").strip()
        if participants:
            members = participants.split("|")
            assert all(member in people for member in members), (name, members)
            assert len(members) == len(set(members)), (name, "duplicate participant")
    print(f"{name}: {len(rows)} rows, total {actual:.2f}")

readme = (root / "README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "split_trip.py" in readme
assert "expenses_partial_refund.csv" in readme
assert "participants" in readme
assert "退款" in readme
ast.parse((root / "split_trip.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print("账单、文档和程序语法只读核验通过")
PY
